scored_events.reasoning: Premier event for wholesale distribution industry executives. NAW is the definitive trade association for distributors across all sectors—core InstaLILY ICP. Jan 2026 timing is ideal. High concentration of mid-market/enterprise decision-makers with multi-location operations and digital transformation mandates.

World's largest HVACR marketplace with 1,800+ exhibitors and 50,000 attendees. HVAC distribution is core vertical for InstaLILY (commercial equipment distributors). Strong exhibitor base of distributors, manufacturers, and channel partners. Feb 2026 timing perfect. Proven commercial equipment supply chain focus.

Manufacturing and supply chain decision-makers conference with WMS integration and automation focus. Attracts some distribution operations leaders, but broader manufacturing/logistics audience. March 2026 timing good. Secondary priority vs. pure distribution events due to mixed attendee base.

Premier event for industrial MROP (Maintenance, Repair, Operations, and Production) supply channel—directly aligned with industrial parts distributors, core InstaLILY vertical. Deep-dive education and networking with distributors, manufacturers, and channel partners. April 2026 timing solid. High concentration of multi-location distributors with complex SKU catalogs.

Explicitly focused on distribution digital transformation, AI applications, and hybrid sales—perfectly aligned with InstaLILY value prop. Co-hosted with NAW ensures quality distribution attendees. May 2026 timing ideal. Directly addresses pain points: sales enablement, data analytics, and AI for distribution operations.

Dedicated field service and support conference with AI Advisory Lab and technology focus. Field service is core InstaLILY vertical. Targets service operations leaders looking to leverage technology for revenue growth. August 2026 timing good. Workforce development and AI adoption angles directly aligned with InstaLILY positioning.

Technology-focused showcase designed for America's largest distribution companies. NAW backing ensures premium attendee base. Explicitly features AI, digitization, and automation startups—positioning InstaLILY as solution vendor. Sept 2026 timing excellent. High concentration of innovation-seeking distribution executives at scale-up companies.

Specialty Tools & Fasteners Distributors Association with 4,300+ industry leaders. Fastener and specialty hardware distribution is core InstaLILY vertical. 50th annual convention signals prestigious, well-attended event. Construction/industrial supply chain focus. Nov 2026 timing good. High concentration of multi-location distributors with tribal knowledge and manual workflow challenges.

Premier HVACR distribution industry event with 4-day format and dedicated tracks on business growth and organizational development. HVACR distribution is core vertical (commercial equipment). Premium venue (San Diego) and exclusive distributor/manufacturer/vendor mix. Dec 2026 timing acceptable (end of year). Strong signal for mid-market HVAC distributors.

Supply chain and retail logistics conference focused on last-mile delivery and warehouse operations. Tangentially related to distribution operations but heavily weighted toward retail/logistics tech, not traditional B2B distribution. May 2026 timing acceptable. Lower priority vs. core distribution/field service events due to retail/eCommerce focus.

Global container shipping and supply chain conference focused on tariff mitigation and shipper cost reduction. Not aligned with InstaLILY verticals (distribution, field service, industrial parts). Attendees are importers, freight forwarders, and port operators—not distribution decision-makers. March 2026 timing acceptable but low priority.

Dedicated to retailers, grocers, and product manufacturers—not B2B distributors or field service providers. Focus is on end-to-end retail supply chain management from CPG and retail perspective. Not aligned with InstaLILY's distribution supply-side focus. Feb 2026 timing good but wrong audience for core verticals.

Exclusive platform for 200+ senior supply chain executives with focus on process optimization and digital transformation. May attract some distributor executives, but broader supply chain audience (manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers). April 2026 timing acceptable but TBD specific dates. Lower priority vs. vertical-specific events. Smaller attendee base (200) vs. NAW/STAFDA.

500+ senior supply chain executives from retailers, manufacturers, and logistics providers. Mixed audience not specifically tailored to B2B distribution. Focus on resilience, AI, and automation is relevant but attendee base skews retail/manufacturing. May 2026 timing acceptable but TBD dates. Lower priority due to mixed vertical focus.

Largest commercial construction industry event with 1,400+ exhibitors. Building materials and construction supply distribution is core InstaLILY vertical. Strong exhibitor base includes construction supply distributors. Jan 2026 timing ideal (early year). High concentration of contractors, builders, and supply distributors with complex procurement needs.

World's largest light construction show focused on residential construction industry. Building materials distribution tangentially relevant but residential focus is less aligned than commercial/industrial. Feb 2026 timing acceptable but TBD dates. Primary attendees are builders/contractors, not distributors. Secondary priority vs. World of Concrete.

Associated General Contractors convention focused on GCs and construction executives. Building materials distribution tangentially present but primary attendees are contractors, not distributors. March 2026 timing acceptable. National-level networking valuable but lower priority vs. vertical-specific distribution events. Secondary audience for InstaLILY.

Brings together owners, GCs, architects, and engineers—procurement focus not on supply distribution. Design-build methodology focus is not aligned with distributor operations or field service. Nov 2026 timing acceptable but lower priority. Building materials distribution presence likely minimal. Not optimal use of resources vs. core vertical events.

Largest facilities management conference with 400+ providers and 90+ education sessions. Field service and facility management operations overlap with InstaLILY field service vertical (equipment maintenance, repair, technician support). March 2026 timing good. However, facilities management (building/property operations) differs from equipment service operations. Moderate priority.

summary.recommendation: Focus lead generation and booth investment on Tier 1 events (5 events scoring 9.0+). These represent the core distribution, industrial parts, and fastener verticals with premium attendee bases and explicit digital transformation/AI focus. Secondary focus on Tier 2 events (4 events scoring 8.0-8.9) which cover HVAC, field service, and construction supply segments. Deprioritize Tier 3 and below due to mixed audiences, retail/logistics focus, or weak distributor alignment.
